# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 18 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Size — 5 tokens; Duration — 7 tokens; Easing — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the siang theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #f5f7fc);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="malam" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the malam column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #12152b);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f5f7fc;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | siang | malam | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #f5f7fc | #12152b | Latar aplikasi di luar ruang pet: area meter, dock aksi, layar pengaturan. |
| `--surface-raised` | #ffffff | #1c2142 | Isi ActionButton, StatusMeter, StageBadge, VacationNote, dan sheet. Selalu dipasangkan dengan garis `stroke`. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the siang theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #1f2340);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="malam" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the malam column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #eef1ff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #1f2340;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | siang | malam | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #1f2340 | #eef1ff | Semua teks dan ikon UI di atas `surface`, `surface-raised`, dan `room`. Minimal 12.6:1 di kedua tema. |
| `--ink-muted` | #555c7d | #a9b0d6 | Teks pendukung (umur, keterangan, huruf z saat tidur) di atas `surface`, `surface-raised`, dan `room`. Minimal 5.4:1 di kedua tema. |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the siang theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--outline, #d3d9ea);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="malam" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the malam column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--outline, #30386a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #d3d9ea;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | siang | malam | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--outline` | #d3d9ea | #30386a | Pemisah dan garis dekoratif yang tidak membawa makna. Jangan dipakai sebagai batas kontrol; itu tugas `stroke`. |
| `--stroke` | #1f2340 | #9aa3d4 | Garis tebal ala stiker di sekeliling setiap kontrol dan kartu. Minimal 6:1 terhadap `surface`, `surface-raised`, dan `room` di kedua tema, jadi batas kontrol tidak pernah bergantung pada warna isi. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the siang theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--room, #ddebff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="malam" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the malam column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--room, #1e2550);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ddebff;
```

### Tokens (18)

| token | siang | malam | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--room` | #ddebff | #1e2550 | Latar ruang pet (panggung tempat pet berdiri) dan EvolutionReveal. Siang = langit pagi, Malam = langit malam. |
| `--yolk` | #ffc83d | #ffd35c | Warna kuning telur, identitas TamaFlutter. Isi tombol utama (Button primary), chip ikon Lampu, dan tubuh karakter Si Seimbang. Selalu bergaris `stroke`, karena di Siang kontrasnya rendah terhadap latar. |
| `--accent` | #2258d6 | #86aaff | Tautan teks, switch dan pilihan aktif di layar pengaturan. Teks `accent` aman di atas `surface` dan `surface-raised` (minimal 5.7:1). |
| `--focus-ring` | #2258d6 | #86aaff | Cincin fokus keyboard dan TalkBack: 3px solid, jarak 3px. Minimal 5:1 terhadap `surface`, `surface-raised`, dan `room` di kedua tema. |
| `--meter-hunger` | #c86400 | #ffa552 | Isi meter Kenyang dan chip ikon Makan. 3.3:1 terhadap `meter-track` (Siang). Meter selalu diberi ikon dan label, jadi tidak dibedakan dari `meter-happy` lewat warna saja. |
| `--meter-happy` | #d13f78 | #ff86b0 | Isi meter Senang dan chip ikon Main. 3.7:1 terhadap `meter-track` (Siang). |
| `--meter-track` | #e6eaf4 | #2c335f | Bagian kosong pada pip meter. |
| `--attention` | #e0353c | #ff6b6e | Hanya titik panggilan (attention dot) saat pet butuh sesuatu, versi ramah dari ikon panggilan Tamagotchi asli. Bukan untuk error, bukan untuk teks. |
| `--sick` | #4e8a22 | #8ccb5c | Chip ikon Obat, pipi pet saat sakit, dan ikon status sakit. Hijau pucat dipakai, bukan merah, supaya sakit tidak terasa menakutkan. |
| `--pet-ink` | #1f2340 | #1f2340 | Garis luar, mata, dan mulut pet, serta ikon di dalam chip berwarna. Sama di kedua tema karena selalu di atas tubuh pet atau chip yang terang (minimal 3.4:1). |
| `--pet-highlight` | #ffffff | #ffffff | Kilau kecil di mata pet. |
| `--pet-cheek` | #ff8fa3 | #ff8fa3 | Pipi merona pet saat senang atau biasa. |
| `--pet-egg` | #fff1c9 | #fff1c9 | Cangkang telur pada tahap Telur. |
| `--char-seimbang` | #ffc83d | #ffd35c | Tubuh Si Seimbang, juga Bayi, Anak, dan Remaja sebelum evolusi. |
| `--char-atletis` | #5ccb91 | #5ccb91 | Tubuh Si Atletis (sering diajak main). |
| `--char-gembul` | #ffb36b | #ffb36b | Tubuh Si Gembul (sering diberi camilan) dan chip ikon Camilan. |
| `--char-rapi` | #86c8fa | #86c8fa | Tubuh Si Rapi (kandang selalu bersih), chip ikon Bersihkan, dan tetes air mata atau keringat pet. |
| `--char-mandiri` | #b9a3f2 | #b9a3f2 | Tubuh Si Mandiri (sering ditinggal). |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 34px/38px "Fredoka", "Baloo 2", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-tm-display);
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tm-display` | `.tm-display`, `--text-tm-display` | 34px / 38px | 600 | `display` | Satu kali per layar: nama karakter di EvolutionReveal. |
| `tm-title` | `.tm-title`, `--text-tm-title` | 24px / 30px | 600 | `display` | Judul kartu dan sheet: VacationNote, judul layar Pengaturan. |
| `tm-numeral` | `.tm-numeral`, `--text-tm-numeral` | 20px / 24px | 600 | `display` | Angka yang boleh dilihat anak: umur pet, jam tidur. |
| `tm-body` | `.tm-body`, `--text-tm-body` | 18px / 28px | 400 | `body` | Kalimat yang dibaca anak. Maksimal dua kalimat per blok. |
| `tm-label` | `.tm-label`, `--text-tm-label` | 15px / 20px | 600 | `body` | Label tombol, label meter, isi StageBadge. |
| `tm-caption` | `.tm-caption`, `--text-tm-caption` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `body` | Keterangan kecil dalam `ink-muted`. Ukuran terkecil di aplikasi; tidak ada teks di bawah 14px. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Fredoka", "Baloo 2", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `body` | `--font-body` | `"Lexend", system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Jarak ikon ke label di dalam ActionButton. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Celah antar-ActionButton dan antar-pip meter yang berdekatan. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Padding dalam chip dan StageBadge. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Gutter layar dan padding kartu. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Jarak antar-kelompok: ruang pet, meter, dock aksi. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Padding EvolutionReveal dan margin atas judul layar. |

## Shadow

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-lip: 0 4px 0 #1f2340 in the siang theme; the table gives its value in the others) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-lip), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-lip` | 0 4px 0 #1f2340 · malam: 0 4px 0 #070914 | Bibir keras di bawah tombol, seperti tombol mainan plastik. Hanya untuk yang bisa ditekan. |
| `--shadow-lip-pressed` | 0 1px 0 #1f2340 · malam: 0 1px 0 #070914 | Saat ditekan: tombol turun 3px dan bibirnya menipis. |
| `--shadow-float` | 0 8px 24px rgba(31, 35, 64, 0.14) · malam: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) | Satu-satunya bayangan lembut: VacationNote dan sheet yang melayang di atas ruang pet. |

## Size

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--size-touch-min: 48px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--size-touch-min), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--size-touch-min` | 48px | Target sentuh minimum apa pun (P0-3). Ikon tombol pengaturan pun 48 x 48. |

| `--size-pip` | 16px | Tinggi pip meter. |

## Duration

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--dur-press: 90ms) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--dur-press), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dur-press` | 90ms | Tombol turun saat ditekan. |
| `--dur-blink` | 120ms | Satu kedipan mata pet. Jeda antar-kedipan 3-5 detik dari Random ber-seed. |
| `--dur-react` | 360ms | Reaksi aksi: lompat saat makan atau main, berputar saat dibersihkan. |
| `--dur-shake` | 420ms | Geleng kepala saat aksi ditolak: tiga ayunan. |
| `--dur-meter` | 400ms | Pip meter terisi atau berkurang. |
| `--dur-reveal` | 1200ms | Urutan EvolutionReveal: kilau, siluet, karakter baru. |
| `--dur-breathe` | 2400ms | Satu siklus napas pet saat diam (skala 1.00 ke 1.03 dan kembali). |

## Easing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--ease-standard), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ease-standard` | cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) | Perpindahan UI biasa: meter, sheet. Flutter: Curves.easeOutCubic sudah cukup dekat. |
| `--ease-bounce` | cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) | Reaksi pet dan tombol lepas tekan. Flutter: Curves.easeOutBack. |
| `--ease-breathe` | cubic-bezier(0.37, 0, 0.63, 1) | Napas pet, bolak-balik tanpa henti. Flutter: Curves.easeInOutSine. |
